snippet.title: Gungrave G.O.R.E: Blood Heat - Action Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10017895/

Grave is back in action in GUNGRAVE G.O.R.E: BLOOD HEAT. Get a new look at the game’s over-the-top combat, featuring the new Parry and Parry Counter mechanics, explosive gunplay, and Grave’s new close-range attacks.

#ps5 #ps5games #gungrave
